comparison.objective: Sort six folded garments by color and override color sorting for red hand-wash tags; candidate finishes threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Garment perception, handling, and placement versus precision tool alignment, bimanual hammering, and millimetre-scale metal-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Garments reach the prescribed baskets or mesh bag; no specs or placement thresholds provided. Candidate requires four safe fractures and complete tang containment.
comparison.reason: Rule-based deformable-object sorting is meaningfully different from contact-loaded tang fracture and retained-insert protection.
